name: prompt-on-change
description: Detect URL/HTML/JSON field changes and promote a prompt event with previous and new state. Use when polling a page or API, watching a CSS/JSONPath/regex field or HTTP status/headers, firing on change, numeric or date range (inside/outside), regex match/non-match, empty, or compound delta (any/all/when empty/http). Script-backed detect engine; calendar actions optional.
